The concept of production and specialization is closely related to the idea of comparative advantage. Explain how a country can benefit from specializing in the production of a particular good, even if it is not the most efficient producer of that good.

options.A: By producing a good that it is relatively good at producing, a country can increase its overall productivity and efficiency.
options.B: By specializing in the production of a good, a country can reduce its costs and increase its competitiveness in the global market.
options.C: By producing a good that it is relatively good at producing, a country can increase its exports and earn more foreign exchange.
options.D: By specializing in the production of a good, a country can reduce its dependence on imports and increase its self-sufficiency.

questions.stem: A company is considering two different marketing strategies for its new product. The first strategy involves a high level of advertising and promotion, while the second strategy involves a low level of advertising and promotion. Which strategy is more likely to be effective in increasing sales?

options.A: The high level of advertising and promotion is more likely to be effective in increasing sales.
options.B: The low level of advertising and promotion is more likely to be effective in increasing sales.
options.C: Both strategies are equally effective in increasing sales.

questions.stem: A company is considering the use of just-in-time (JIT) inventory management system. What are the advantages and disadvantages of using a JIT system?

options.A: Advantages: reduced inventory costs, improved product quality, and increased efficiency. Disadvantages: increased risk of stockouts, higher transportation costs, and reduced flexibility.
options.B: Advantages: reduced inventory costs, improved product quality, and increased efficiency. Disadvantages: increased risk of stockouts, higher transportation costs, and reduced flexibility.
options.C: Advantages: reduced inventory costs, improved product quality, and increased efficiency. Disadvantages: increased risk of stockouts, higher transportation costs, and reduced flexibility.
options.D: Advantages: reduced inventory costs, improved product quality, and increased efficiency. Disadvantages: increased risk of stockouts, higher transportation costs, and reduced flexibility.

questions.stem: A bank's primary objective is to maximize shareholder value. Which of the following is a correct statement regarding the bank's role in the economy?

options.C: To act as a financial intermediary between savers and borrowers.
options.D: To print money to finance government spending.

questions.stem: A warehouse manager is responsible for ensuring that goods are stored and retrieved efficiently. Which of the following is a correct statement regarding the warehouse's inventory management system?

options.B: The system uses a last-in, first-out (LIFO) inventory rotation method.
options.C: The system uses a just-in-time (JIT) inventory management system.

options.C: The production process involves the manufacture of goods using a combination of human labor and machine-based automation.

options.B: Specialization leads to increased productivity and efficiency because it allows firms to take advantage of their comparative advantage, leading to a more efficient allocation of resources.
